checks.assessment: Typed UUID identity and duplicate-role 409 are explicit. Missing references map to 404 and inactive ones to 409 after deterministic locks in the create transaction. The unique username constraint is the race authority and must produce 409 for the loser.

checks.subject: Atomic business and necessary writes
checks.assessment: Current creation commits before calling a separate audit transaction. The frozen repair joins the user, role rows, primary membership, required audit after snapshot and pending session flush into one transaction. Any necessary write failure rolls all of them back. Other user commands remain out of scope.
